// Generated companion for private P06 page navigation. No routing/backend is supplied.
package converted

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"path"
	"strings"
	"unicode"
	"unicode/utf8"

	"github.com/a-h/templ"
)

type NavigationItem struct { Key, Label, URL string }
type PageNavigation struct {
	Items []NavigationItem
	CurrentKey, NavLabel, SelectLabel string
}
type NavigationGET struct { Action, FieldName, SubmitLabel string }

// Reference preserves the unbound source select and may retain '#' placeholders.
// It is a design specimen, not usable navigation at narrow widths.
func NewPageNavigationReference(data PageNavigation) (templ.Component, error) {
	return newPageNavigation(data, "reference", NavigationGET{})
}
// GET uses explicit native submission. The app maps FieldName's stable key to an
// allowlisted route; never redirect directly to an untrusted submitted destination.
func NewPageNavigationGET(data PageNavigation, form NavigationGET) (templ.Component, error) {
	return newPageNavigation(data, "get", form)
}
// Links is the static-site adaptation: ordinary wrapping page links, no script.
func NewPageNavigationLinks(data PageNavigation) (templ.Component, error) {
	return newPageNavigation(data, "links", NavigationGET{})
}

type navigationView struct { PageNavigation; Mode string; Form NavigationGET }

func newPageNavigation(data PageNavigation, mode string, form NavigationGET) (templ.Component, error) {
	if len(data.Items) < 2 || len(data.Items) > 12 || !navigationText(data.NavLabel) || !navigationText(data.SelectLabel) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("page navigation: invalid item count or accessible label")
	}
	keys, urls := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range data.Items {
		if !navigationKey(item.Key) || keys[item.Key] || !navigationText(item.Label) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("page navigation: invalid or duplicate item key/label")
		}
		keys[item.Key] = true
		placeholder := mode == "reference" && item.URL == "#"
		if !placeholder && (!navigationPath(item.URL) || urls[item.URL]) {
			return nil, fmt.Errorf("page navigation: invalid or duplicate local path")
		}
		urls[item.URL] = true
	}
	if !keys[data.CurrentKey] { return nil, fmt.Errorf("page navigation: current key missing") }
	if mode == "get" && (!navigationPath(form.Action) || !navigationKey(form.FieldName) || !navigationText(form.SubmitLabel)) {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("page navigation: invalid native GET contract")
	}
	data.Items = append([]NavigationItem(nil), data.Items...)
	return pageNavigation(navigationView{data, mode, form}), nil
}

func navigationText(s string) bool {
	if len(s) > 256 || !utf8.ValidString(s) || strings.TrimSpace(s) == "" { return false }
	for _, r := range s { if unicode.IsControl(r) { return false } }
	return true
}
func navigationKey(s string) bool {
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > 64 { return false }
	for i, c := range []byte(s) {
		letter := c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z'
		if !letter && (i == 0 || !(c >= '0' && c <= '9' || c == '-' || c == '_')) { return false }
	}
	return true
}
func navigationPath(s string) bool {
	if len(s) == 0 || len(s) > 512 || s[0] != '/' || path.Clean(s) != s { return false }
	for _, c := range []byte(s) {
		if !(c >= 'a' && c <= 'z' || c >= 'A' && c <= 'Z' || c >= '0' && c <= '9' || strings.ContainsRune("/._-~", rune(c))) { return false }
	}
	return true
}

func navigationLinkClass(current bool, mode string) string {
	c := navigationDefaultClass
	if current { c = navigationCurrentClass }
	if mode == "reference" { return c }
	return strings.Replace(c, "whitespace-nowrap", "whitespace-normal", 1) + " min-h-11 min-w-11 max-w-full [overflow-wrap:anywhere] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-indigo-600 dark:focus-visible:outline-indigo-400"
}
func navigationSelectStyle(mode string) string {
	if mode == "reference" { return navigationSelectClass }
	return navigationSelectClass + " min-h-11"
}
func navigationNavStyle(mode string) string {
	if mode == "reference" { return navigationNavClass }
	return "-mb-px flex flex-wrap gap-x-8 gap-y-2"
}

// Go repetition retains exact source whitespace; templ control-flow does not.
func navigationItems(data navigationView, options bool) templ.Component {
	return templ.ComponentFunc(func(ctx context.Context, w io.Writer) error {
		for i, item := range data.Items {
			if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil { return err }
			if i > 0 {
				separator := navigationLinkSeparator
				if options { separator = navigationOptionSeparator }
				if _, err := io.WriteString(w, separator); err != nil { return err }
			}
			component := navigationLink(item, item.Key == data.CurrentKey, data.Mode)
			if options { component = navigationOption(item, item.Key == data.CurrentKey, data) }
			if err := component.Render(ctx, w); err != nil { return err }
		}
		return nil
	})
}
func navigationNarrow(data navigationView) templ.Component {
	switch data.Mode {
	case "get": return navigationGETForm(data)
	case "links": return navigationMobileLinks(data)
	default: return navigationMobile(data)
	}
}
